methodologyNotes: Dataset covers 12 digital (electronic) calipers spanning premium Japanese/US metrology brands (Mitutoyo, Starrett, Fowler), a mid-tier import staple (iGaging), and the budget import tier that dominates unit sales on Amazon (Neiko, Clockwise Tools, VINCA, Insize, Shahe, General Tools, Adoric). Specs verified against manufacturer/distributor product pages (mitutoyo via itm.com and homelectrical.com distributor listings — Mitutoyo does not sell direct-to-consumer or publish a public USD MSRP, so distributor list price is used and flagged; starrett.com family page cross-checked against globaltestsupply.com and higherprecision.com; fowler via kbctools.com; igaging via penntoolco.com and lighttoolsupply.com; clockwise tools via jetsinc.com; insize via the manufacturer's own 1108.pdf datasheet plus alloycoatingsupply.com for price; general tools via the manufacturer's generaltools.com product page). accessedAt 2026-08-01 for all entries. priceUsd is the lowest confirmed authorized-distributor/retailer price found; where no manufacturer MSRP or single stable USD retail price could be confirmed (Neiko 01407A, Shahe 5110-150 — both sold only through fragmented marketplace listings with prices ranging roughly $18-50 depending on channel/promotion), priceUsd is null rather than guessed. Adversarial corrections this pass: seed model 'iGaging 100-333-08' does not exist — the real SKU is 100-333-8 (no leading zero), confirmed on travers.com, penntoolco.com and the manufacturer's own user manual; corrected throughout. Seed 'Mitutoyo 500-197-30' is confirmed a real, but now-obsolete, SKU per mrosupply.com ('this model is obsolete'); priceUsd left null and the current replacement (500-197-32, $226.55) noted in priceNote rather than substituted, since the -30 and -32 suffixes denote different data-output configurations (Mitutoyo's 500-series -30 suffix = no SPC/data output, -32 suffix = with data output) and swapping would misrepresent the named product. The same -30/no-output convention was verified for 500-196-30. Starrett's 798A-6/150 (this dataset) is the no-output variant; the near-identical 798B-6/150 adds RS232/SPC output — some third-party listing copy conflates the two and was NOT trusted for the data_output field. ip_rating is left null (not false/'none') wherever a manufacturer does not publish a formal IP certification for that specific model, even if marketing copy claims generic 'splash resistance' (e.g., Mitutoyo 500-196-30's AOS sensor vs. the explicitly IP67-rated 500-197 'Coolant Proof' line). IMAGE NOTE: 7 of 12 products carry a directly WebFetch-verified manufacturer/distributor product photo (visually confirmed to show the correct brand marking before inclusion — one candidate iGaging photo was rejected mid-pass because it showed a reseller's own 'Penn Tool Co.' logo stamped on the frame rather than iGaging's, and a correctly-branded replacement photo was sourced instead). For the remaining 5 (Neiko 01407A, VINCA DCLA-0605, Insize 1108-150, Shahe 5110-150, Adoric) no direct image URL could be retrieved this pass — the small-storefront sites carrying these budget-import models (Shopify/BigCommerce storefronts: clockwisetools.com, woodartsupply.com, nationalwpsupply.com, hroberts-di.com, equipementpolar.com, measurementsupply.com, and Amazon's JS-rendered listing pages) consistently returned 429/500 errors to repeated automated fetches, or genuinely had no product photo uploaded (alloycoatingsupply.com's Insize listing shows a literal 'Coming-Soon.jpg' placeholder); per instructions the image key is omitted rather than fabricated or left null for these five.
